name: KyIdentity
description: Sign-in, users and MFA for the Ky Suite (Busnes) and any OpenID Connect app.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The user database, the token signing key, the secret and encryption keys (made on first start) and first-run-password.txt. Back up the whole folder: without the keys, MFA secrets can't be read and connected apps must be paired again.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: KyIdentity web app and OpenID Connect provider, published on host as 6695

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: KYIDENTITY_ISSUER_URL
variables.description: Required. The https address of KyIdentity through your reverse proxy, like https://id.example.com. KyIdentity refuses to start with an http address other than http://localhost:6695, and every connected app signs in through this address. Never change it after apps are connected.

variables.name: KYIDENTITY_DATA_DIR
variables.description: Where KyIdentity keeps its data inside the container. Leave it as /data.

variables.name: BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_USER
variables.description: The user name of the first administrator, made on first start.

variables.name: BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASS
variables.description: The first administrator's password. Leave it empty to have one made for you: it is saved in first-run-password.txt in the data folder (/mnt/cache/appdata/kyidentity/data). You choose a new password at the first sign-in either way.
